name: Enzo Hins
tagline: Security research at Virginia's Commonwealth Cyber Initiative. CTFs, blue team, red team, programming competitions and hackathons.
about: Computer science sophomore at JMU, focusing on software engineering and cybersecurity. Most of my time goes to competitions, club work, projects and research.
I fill the role the team needs and learn what the job takes. On defense that has meant administering a Palo Alto firewall and hardening Linux and Windows systems.

I'm highly proficient with AI tools. I understand how they work, what they do well, and how to get the best results from them. For VMI CyberFusion I built an AI-assisted CTF orchestrator that solved the Microsoft CTF challenges early in the competition, ahead of every other team. My partner and I placed first and second.

I love math, and it's what leads me into machine learning, AI and the theory behind them. I also like reading (classics, psychology, philosophy, politics, history, and fantasy, especially Forgotten Realms).
I've lived in Moscow, Russia; Beijing, China; and Frankfurt, Germany.
I have a strong drive to serve my country (USA) with my skills in software engineering and cybersecurity. I also find research and private sector work fulfilling.
Outside of academics: skateboarding, weightlifting, Brazilian jiu-jitsu, Old School RuneScape, and automating things with AI.

experience.text: Sole cybersecurity researcher on HGN-Sense, an ML system that flags impairment from Horizontal Gaze Nystagmus eye movements. I implement all of its security (AES-256-GCM encryption of biometric data, model weight protection, anti-spoofing) and help lead the software engineering, data collection and machine learning work.
Shipped AI search and AI sticker and text generation to production on a greeting card platform. Researched local model hosting.
Run the club and compete in programming contests and hackathons. Building the next generation of competitive programmers at JMU.
Compete for the club, network and build relationships with members, and assist the executive board.
